concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-pci-dss-compliance-guide-script-security]] — Adyen PCI DSS v4.0.1 Web payment-page script-security guidance (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for SAQ D/AoC and partner contexts, CSP/SRI inventory and alerting recommendations, and SAQ A exclusion.
warnings: The source's SRI example heading says v5.59.1 while its resource URLs say v5.59.0; do not promote the example as verified for either release.
The displayed blocking CSP uses broad wildcards and omits Mastercard/Visa domains that appear in its own inventory table; do not treat it as a ready compliance template.
